title: calculator-ui (M3) Slice 1: app copy as data, the ad protocol, the profile store, the manifest, the environment
body:
Plan: `docs/plans/calculator-ui.md`, Slice 1 (app copy as data from the owner-approved `docs/APP_COPY.md` through `scripts/build-app-copy.sh` — D-2026-09-03-F7; the skin-type table and Fitzpatrick quiz; `AdBannerProvider` + `NoAdsProvider`; `ProfileStore`; `ScreenManifest` / `ScreenTable`; `AppEnvironment`; the app shell; `acceptance/S11.sh`, `S15.sh`). Slices 2–4 follow on `feat/calculator-ui-2` after learn-tab Slice 2. Stacked on `feat/learn-tab`. 457 Linux tests; S11 and S15 pass on Linux.

IcarusUI, IcarusAds and `App/` are Apple-only and were NOT compiled here (no SwiftUI on Linux); the macOS `test` job is their first compiler. `IcarusContent` now depends on `IcarusCore` (`AppCopy.text` takes a `CopyKey`), which the plan's signatures imply. No blind test edited.
